create_memory_fact: create a memory fact with content, category, and confidence level for an agent
delete_memory_fact: delete a memory fact by its unique fact id from stored memory data
update_memory_from_conversation: update agent memory from conversation messages with correction and reinforcement signals
clear_memory_data: clear all stored memory data and persist an empty memory structure for an agent
import_memory_data: import and persist a full memory payload into storage for a specified agent
